from collections import defaultdict
data = """\
col:  | Schedule Time    | Actual Time  |
row 1: | -10:25_A.M.       | 10:28 A.M.     |
row 2: | 9:05-a.m.       | 9:05 A.M.      |
row 3: | --8:29-P.M.--   | 8:30 P.M.      |
col: flight
row 1: AA-1917-JFK-MCO
row 2: AA-3804-PHL-ORD
row 3: CO-1023-IAH-DEN
row 4: UA-37-EWR-MCO
row 5: AA-1640-MIA-MCO
row 6: CO-62-IAH-EWR
row 7: CO-16-LAX-EWR
row 8: AA-3786-IAH-ORD
row 9: CO-16-LAX-EWR
row 10: AA-3468-CVG-MIA
row 11: AA-4277-CVG-JFK
row 12: UA-843-LAX-ORD
row 13: UA-2708-EWR-CLT
row 14: AA-1917-JFK-MCO
row 15: AA-85-JFK-SFO
row 16: CO-1023-IAH-DEN
row 17: UA-3099-PHX-PHL
row 18: AA-1664-MIA-ATL
row 19: UA-938-DEN-ORD
row 20: AA-59-JFK-SFO"""

flights = defaultdict(int)
for row in data.split('\n\n'):
    if 'flight' in row:
        continue
    match = re.match(r'(\w+)-', row)
    if match:
        flights[match.group(1)] += 1

for airline, count in flights.items():
    print("%s" % ({airline}: {count}))
